about: Python startup files AAK-STARTUP-HOOK-PTH-001 and AAK-STARTUP-HOOK-SITECUSTOMIZE-001 do not report. An entry matches a file only by its name and the sha256 of its normalised content together, never by name alone: a malicious .pth can call itself distutils-precedence.pth. Every entry was built in a clean environment on the date below; source says which tool wrote it.
normalisation: Decode as UTF-8 (a leading BOM dropped, undecodable bytes replaced), split with str.splitlines(), strip each line, drop blank lines and lines starting with #, join with a newline, encode as UTF-8, sha256.

entries.name: distutils-precedence.pth
entries.source: setuptools 84.2.1 (pip install setuptools on CPython 3.12.12 and 3.15.2), 82.0.1 (seeded by virtualenv 21.15.1 on CPython 3.9.25) and 79.0.1 (ensurepip on CPython 3.9.25); identical in all three
entries.runs: Imports _distutils_hack and installs its shim when SETUPTOOLS_USE_DISTUTILS is unset or 'local'.

entries.name: _virtualenv.pth
entries.source: virtualenv 21.15.1 creating a CPython 3.9.25 environment (it writes none for 3.12.12 or 3.15.2), and uv 0.9.18 `uv venv` on CPython 3.9.25, 3.12.12 and 3.15.2; identical
entries.runs: import _virtualenv, the patch module virtualenv and uv place beside it.

entries.name: __editable__.aak_allowlist_probe-0.0.0.pth
entries.source: setuptools 84.2.1 editable install (pip install -e, PEP 660) of a placeholder project named aak-allowlist-probe 0.0.0 on CPython 3.12.12
entries.runs: Imports the finder setuptools writes for that project and calls its install(). The file is named after the project, so it matches only that project's editable install.

entries.name: a1_coverage.pth
entries.source: coverage 7.13.5, 7.14.0, 7.15.0, 7.16.0 and 7.17.0 wheels (7.17.0 installed by pytest-cov 7.1.0 into a CPython 3.12.12 environment with this project's dev extras); identical
entries.runs: Starts coverage measurement only when COVERAGE_PROCESS_START or COVERAGE_PROCESS_CONFIG is set.

entries.name: a1_coverage.pth
entries.source: coverage 7.13.0 wheel (coverage first ships the file in 7.13.0; 7.10.7, 7.11.0, 7.11.3 and 7.12.0 do not)
